single_operational_change.name: cpu_task_gpu_process_guard_scope
single_operational_change.v1_behavior: Abort when any compute process appears on any physical GPU in the shared host.
single_operational_change.v2_behavior: Record all host GPU compute processes as non-blocking external telemetry. Abort only if nvidia-smi telemetry is unavailable or the task isolation contract is not CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty with backend cpu.
single_operational_change.causal_basis: The v1 trigger was an unrelated CIFAR-100 job owned by liuzc on GPU1, while GPU0 and GPU2-7 were idle and the Mantis collection was CPU-only.
